id: title:jurajmajerik:don t treat completed experiment results as stale

review.posthog_relevance: Updates the ExperimentReloadAction and ExperimentLastRefreshText components to suppress staleness warnings and auto-refresh indicators once an experiment has ended, preventing users from seeing stale status or triggering unnecessary refreshes for completed experiments.
review.reason: Adds conditional staleness suppression: staleness warning and staleness-related auto-refresh are disabled when an experiment has ended.
review.uncertainty: This is a localized UI behavior change. While the implementation is visible, the actual benefit depends on whether the previous behavior was considered a bug or a feature, and the complete context of the experiment lifecycle management is not fully demonstrated. No broader systemic risk reduction or critical path dependency is established.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single-file change group. No cross-PR uncertainty. No missing context. No untrusted instructions.

observations.behavior: Adds conditional staleness suppression: staleness warning and staleness-related auto-refresh are disabled when an experiment has ended.
observations.posthog_connection: The ExperimentReloadAction component checks the experiment status before enabling staleness warnings or auto-refresh polling. This prevents showing stale indicators or triggering refreshes for completed experiments.

observations.behavior: Adds conditional staleness suppression: staleness warning and staleness-related auto-refresh are disabled when an experiment has ended.
observations.posthog_connection: The ExperimentLastRefreshText component now accepts a showStaleness prop and only applies staleness-based styling if staleness is requested and the experiment has not ended.
